source.routeMethod: Shortest undirected OSM road-node path; foot=no/private and access=no/private excluded; endpoints projected to nearest road segment.
limitations: The route is for an in-game prototype, not real-world walking guidance.
Not all sidewalks, crossings, access restrictions or building entrances are mapped or verified.
Building shapes and land cover are incomplete. Decorative art is illustrative, not surveyed geometry.
3-decimal meter rounding only; no artistic relocation of road coordinates.
